controls.checked_by: gravity-dependent torque check
controls.measured: RMS actuator torque falls from 0.10649 to 0.00020 N m
controls.mutation: set model.opt.gravity to zero
controls.what: remove gravity

controls.checked_by: model-consistency check on total moving mass
controls.measured: payload model moving mass 3.7605 kg vs empty 2.7605 kg; a payload run whose mass equals the empty run's is not a payload run
controls.mutation: report the empty model's mass under the payload label
controls.what: remove the 1 kg payload while claiming it is present

controls.checked_by: topology check against the accepted 7-body set
controls.measured: body set becomes 8 entries including a payload, against the accepted 7
controls.mutation: append SCENARIO-PAYLOAD-1KG to the product body set
controls.what: count the scenario payload as a product body

controls.checked_by: gravity-sign check on the torque phase
controls.measured: peak positive torque moves from 105.9 deg to 253.9 deg
controls.mutation: gravity z set to +9.81
controls.what: reverse the gravity vector

controls.checked_by: analytic cross-check of the incremental torque
controls.measured: incremental torque at 113 deg would be 0.05026 N m, not the 0.50262 N m a 1 kg payload gives; the cross-check tolerance is 0.00503
controls.mutation: scale the payload inertial by 0.1 and keep the 1 kg label
controls.what: change the payload mass to 0.1 kg while labelling it 1 kg

controls.checked_by: travel and loop-closure check
controls.measured: with the loop broken the platform no longer follows the crank: it moves 4906.63 mm on its own while the crank is driven
controls.mutation: disable the joint in the model
controls.what: break the crank-to-rod joint

controls.checked_by: travel and loop-closure check
controls.measured: with the platform joint disabled the platform travel becomes 78486.5398 mm and the loop closure error reaches 78474.2730 mm
controls.mutation: disable the joint in the model
controls.what: break the rod-to-platform joint

controls.checked_by: loop-closure and platform-height check
controls.measured: platform pin height at 90 deg moves from 132.1110 mm to 137.9423 mm
controls.mutation: lengthen the rod by 5 mm in the kinematic relation
controls.what: change the connecting-rod length

controls.checked_by: travel check: travel must equal twice the declared crank radius
controls.measured: measured travel would be 80.0 mm, not the 90.0 mm a 45 mm crank gives
controls.mutation: use a 40 mm crank and keep the 45 mm label
controls.what: change the crank radius while claiming 45 mm

controls.checked_by: platform free-fall check
controls.measured: with the linkage constraint removed the platform falls 4906.63 mm in 1 s instead of following the crank
controls.mutation: disable the platform joint equality so the platform is unconstrained by the linkage
controls.what: remove the platform slide constraint

controls.checked_by: measured-travel check
controls.measured: measured travel collapses to 0.0000 mm against the claimed 90 mm
controls.mutation: build the model with the platform slide joint removed, so the platform is welded to the world
controls.what: lock the platform while claiming 90 mm travel

controls.checked_by: incremental-torque check: the difference must be non-zero and must match the analytic payload torque
controls.measured: the incremental RMS would be 0.00000 N m instead of the measured 0.32382 N m
controls.mutation: report the empty run's torque as the payload run's
controls.what: copy the empty torque into the payload report

controls.checked_by: release-independence check
controls.measured: the 16 tested releases give 13 distinct crank displacements; copying one into all would erase that
controls.mutation: replace every release outcome with the 0 deg one
controls.what: copy the bottom release result into all release angles

controls.checked_by: unit and magnitude check on the torque channel
controls.measured: at one sample the command is 1.57080 rad and the measured torque is 0.14906 N m; they are different quantities in different units
controls.mutation: substitute ctrl for actuator_force in the report
controls.what: report the actuator command instead of the measured torque

controls.checked_by: mass plausibility check
controls.measured: the platform would weigh 6.876e+07 kg instead of 0.06876 kg
controls.mutation: compute mass as volume_mm3 * density without the 1e-9 factor
controls.what: omit the unit conversion from mm to m

controls.checked_by: positive-definite and triangle-inequality check on every body
controls.measured: eigenvalues [-1.0, 1.0, 1.0] contain a non-positive value; MuJoCo also rejects such a model at load time, which is how the real defect in this session's first inertia derivation was caught
controls.mutation: set one principal inertia negative
controls.what: use invalid or non-positive inertia

controls.checked_by: in-run divergence watch (Divergence.look), reported per run as divergence_watch
controls.measured: the watch sees {'nonfinite_samples': 0, 'max_abs_qpos': 109148.725996, 'max_warning_total_seen': 1, 'state_jump_detected': True}. An END-OF-RUN warning delta reports ZERO here, because mj_checkPos resets MjData and clears the counters - which is precisely the failure this control exists to catch, and which it did catch.
controls.mutation: run with a 0.02 s timestep, far beyond the servo's stability limit
controls.what: hide solver divergence

controls.checked_by: claim-fidelity scan: a jamming claim requires contact-resolving evidence
controls.measured: the ideal guide resolves no contact, so it cannot carry a jamming verdict (NRM-BM-002-014, NEG-BM-002-011); the scan flags it
controls.mutation: assert REQ-007 PASS citing the prismatic guide
controls.what: claim jamming PASS from the ideal prismatic guide model

controls.checked_by: claim-fidelity scan: a strength claim requires stress evidence
controls.measured: a reaction force is not a stress and this model computes no stress; the scan flags it
controls.mutation: assert REQ-003 payload capacity PASS citing joint reaction forces
controls.what: claim strength PASS from rigid-body dynamics

controls.checked_by: trajectory SHA-256 recorded in each video manifest
controls.measured: trajectory hash changes from 61c64403b72d8ef6 to 095ae27905760365
controls.mutation: shift every crank angle by 1 degree before hashing the frame trajectory
controls.what: generate a video from a trajectory different from the reported one

name: simulation negative controls
purpose: Establishes that the simulation checks can fail. Each control perturbs the model, the data or the claim in memory and passes only if the corresponding check reports it. No perturbed model is exported.
